decision: Ticket 06 closes with one accepted exception: the blind-baseline freeze keeps writing its two fixed-name files itself. The explicit-path branch of write_report is removed. Six behaviour changes made by the ticket are accepted.

rules.rule: harness/blind_baseline.py freeze_baseline writes blind_baseline_<short>.json and blind_baseline_<short>.freeze.json itself, not through record_chain.write_record. It loads through the chain (FREEZE_KIND).
rules.basis: Operator decision in session, 2026-11-11 (option 1). write_record writes numbered names only; giving the freeze numbered names would change the record format, which ticket 06 forbids. The committed freeze under docs/tier4_orchestration_state/msca_dn/baselines/ uses the fixed names.

rules.rule: harness/blind_assessment.py write_report takes no explicit path. Every blind report is written through the chain at the next numbered name.
rules.basis: Operator instruction in session, 2026-11-11. The branch had no caller outside one test; the test now asserts the parameter is gone.

rules.rule: record_chain gains write_rendering, which writes a Markdown rendering at the next numbered .md path. load_record and write_record are unchanged.
rules.basis: Operator acceptance in session, 2026-11-11. The operator review's Markdown file has no JSON record for write_record.

rules.rule: The audit, preflight and review-notes kinds declare no predecessor. A loaded audit does not re-hash its blind baseline.
rules.basis: Operator acceptance in session, 2026-11-11. The committed audits under docs/tier4_orchestration_state/msca_dn/audit/ record baseline_dir as an absolute path in the main checkout, so a re-hash would refuse them in any other checkout, including the host bundle. The comparison re-hashes the same frozen report. The preflight binds by content hash; build_review still compares the notes' comparison hash.

rules.rule: The operator review loads its comparison through load_record(COMPARISON_KIND) and takes the comparison's file hash from the chain; _expect_sha is removed.

Refusal wording for the migrated links comes from the chain: an edited frozen copy reads 'moved after the freeze was written' with short hashes; 'report file not found' becomes 'report not found'; review-notes flags are checked before required keys. Error classes are unchanged.
Temp-file prefixes change to blind_, preflight_, integrity_ and operator_review_. Written bytes are unchanged.
rules.basis: Operator acceptance in session, 2026-11-11; the same kind of change as overhaul-05-revisions-hash-gap_2026-11-11 C4.

rules.rule: blind_assessment.next_report_path and operator_review.next_markdown_path are removed. Numbered paths come from content_hash.next_numbered_path through the chain.
rules.basis: Operator acceptance in session, 2026-11-11. Neither had a caller outside tests.
